name: email-campaign-create
title: Create an email campaign draft
summary: Create a Brevo email campaign as a draft from finished HTML, for a chosen list and a verified sender.

tool_notes.email_campaign_management_create_email_c: Create campaigns as drafts only: never pass scheduledAt or sendAtBestTime. Sending or scheduling is done by the user in Brevo.
tool_notes.email_campaign_management_get_email_camp: Pass excludeHtmlContent true unless you need the HTML: it keeps the response small.
